title: A cleaner view: the HUD's buttons move into the Navigator
items: The row of buttons along the top is gone. What stays is the amber year chip, Walk/Fly and the round compass-map instrument, so far more of the town shows, above all on a phone.
Start / Jaunts now sits in the Navigator's Jaunts app, beside Take a Jaunt.
The Confidence view switch and its Attested, Inferred and Reconstructed levels are in the Navigator's Confidence view app. C still turns the colouring on and off.
Your pace is chosen in Move, and light or dark is in Settings.
The street name now appears for about two seconds when you cross onto a new street, then fades.
